groups.canonical_name: Commodity and semiconductor input cost inflation
groups.definition: Rising prices of steel, metals, and semiconductors increase production costs that may not be passed on to customers.

groups.canonical_name: Semiconductor materials and wafer supply shortages
groups.definition: Limited or constrained supply of silicon wafers, key materials, chemicals, and equipment from few suppliers or geographies could prevent adequate production.
Declining prices for semiconductor products, especially older ones, pressure margins and require cost reductions.
